description.value: This study examined the effect of an alcohol priming dose on BOLD responses to alcohol taste cues in alcohol dependent individuals, including moderation by alcoholism severity and OPRM1 genotype.

spans.text: This study provides initial evidence of alcohol cue-elicited habituation in fronto-temporal regions, despite continued craving, following a priming dose of alcohol.

description.value: Within-subjects, randomized, placebo-controlled alcohol administration study with two fMRI sessions before and after alcohol priming.

spans.text: the present study used a within-subjects design

Twenty individuals with alcohol dependence (6 females; 90% Caucasian; mean age=29.4) who were prospectively genotyped on the OPRM1 gene underwent two functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) sessions, before and after a priming dose of alcohol, each including a gustatory alcohol cue reactivity paradigm and self-reported craving measures.
